payload.taskDescription: Create the Vite 8, React 19, and TypeScript 6 project with the dependency versions in PRD section 6.1. Configure hash-routable index.html, strict TypeScript project references, ESLint 10 with typescript-eslint 8, Prettier, Vitest 5 with jsdom, and Playwright 1.64 with desktop, tablet-landscape, and phone projects. Add scripts dev, build, preview, lint, typecheck, test, test:coverage, and test:e2e, where test:e2e builds before running Playwright. Render a minimal strict-mode App with a smoke test. Do not add feature screens, the board, PWA registration, or CI workflows.
